introHtml: Koozie folding chairs combine the durability of heavy-duty frames with the comfort of padded seats and cup holders. Whether you're outfitting a corporate tailgate, a trade show lounge, or a company picnic, these chairs offer a stable, portable seating solution that keeps your logo visible. Choose from styles like the Camp Throne or the Folding Moon Chair with a 400lb capacity. Decorating with screen printing or embroidery ensures your brand stands out season after season.
